15740542.source: Can 2006 (PMID 15740542) abstract: 'S. boulardii also reduced the risk of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea ... [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]'. ENDPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor took the trial's ANY-diarrhoea figure (9/119 vs 29/127, RR 0.3) but our outcome is ANTIBIOTIC-ASSOCIATED diarrhoea, which the same abstract reports separately as 4/119 vs 22/127 (RR 0.2).
15740542.verification: AAD-specific arm counts 4/119 (3.4%) and 22/127 (17.3%) verbatim in the abstract; RR = (4/119)/(22/127) = 0.194, matching the stated RR 0.2 (0.07-0.5). Corrects an any-diarrhoea-vs-AAD wrong-endpoint (cycle 75 audit).

SCALE CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor pooled the source ODDS RATIO 0.34 into this RR-family pool; the per-arm counts give the count-based RR directly, consistent with the other count-based trials.
18026577.verification: Arm counts 7/44 (15.9%) and 16/45 (35.6%) verbatim in the abstract; count RR = (7/44)/(16/45) = 0.447. Replaces the OR 0.34 the extractor took, removing an OR-in-RR-pool scale mix (cycle 75 audit).
